So, I brought in a packet of twelve ‘picnic eggs’ which are small scotch eggs (don’t know if they exist anywhere but England, but still.) My friend asked, and I gave her a few. We share food often between us because normally only one of us has lunch or we’re agreeing to split or whatever. Then , one of my others friends sat down, asked to try one. I agreed and gave them one. Then, friend three, calling her M, walked over, dumping her bag on the table. She then , literally lunging over the table at my food. Like, she learnt all the way diagonally with her arm outstretched to make a grab at them, not a word said to me. I reacted and pulled them away, holding them under the table. They looked at me and said “ HEY. COME ON- “ And I told them they couldn’t have one. They asked why ‘becuase I gave them two some’ and I said becuase they asked, while she just lunged for my shit without even saying hi to me. M proceeded to plead with me and apologise and ask ‘nicely’. But I told them they’re only saying that becuase I told her to, and didn’t let her have one. Me finishing them off. Apparently I’m the asshole for excluding her, but I was just upset that she lunged straight for my food before even acknowledging me. Everyone else I shared with asked. I guess me refusing her as she attempted to ask again is borderline assholery. Reddit , AITA?
